1155:     ) : RuntimeCommand {

1294:     )

1299:         bodyPositionX = positionX,
1300:         bodyPositionY = positionY,
1301:         bodyPositionZ = positionZ,

1303:         bodyVelocityY = velocityY,

1311:     )

1317:     )

1320: private fun RuntimeObserverMode.startupDisplayLabel(): String = when (this) {
1321:     RuntimeObserverMode.Free -> "Free"
1322:     RuntimeObserverMode.FollowSelected -> "Follow selected"
1323:     RuntimeObserverMode.FollowHost -> "Follow host"
1324:     RuntimeObserverMode.SystemFrame -> "System frame"
1325: }
